description:
The 4StoreyBuilding model is open in eQUEST. This building currently relies on passive infiltration for restroom exhaust, which is causing air quality issues. Your goal is to add mechanical exhaust fans to the Core Zone on every floor (Ground, 2nd, 3rd, and Top).

Navigate to the Air-Side HVAC or Building Shell > Zones section. Locate the central 'Core' zone for each of the 4 floors (typically named with a 'C' suffix, e.g., 'G.C05').

For EACH of these 4 Core zones, set the following parameters:
- Exhaust Air Flow: 300 CFM
- Exhaust Static Pressure: 0.5 in. w.c.
- Exhaust Fan Efficiency: 0.5 (Standard)

After making these changes to all 4 floors, run the annual DOE-2.2 simulation to update the energy results. Save the project when complete.
